about: The stack regression suite (test/stack/run.mjs). Each check is a script here that exits 0 when the stack does what it asks. `expect: "fail"` marks behaviour the stack does not have yet, with the issue that tracks it: such a check passing is a signal, not a success, and the runner says so.

checks.about: founding one strand converges over the phone's LevelDB adapter
a strand founded in the background, started twice: the joiner gets in
foreground- and background-founded strands both run again after a restart
a founding interrupted by a stop resumes, and the strand is writable
a replicated row survives a restart while its writer is offline
a strand opens after a schema change (a column tag) with its other member offline
an Optimystic table uses an index wherever a memory table does (Optimystic#52)
an app's private tables in the cadre's control database
two parties form a strand through a relay, writes cross both ways
two relay-only parties converge again after a restart
a join requested while the inviter is offline completes on its own (requestJoin, sereus#25)
a strand schema can declare a blobref column (sereus#67, gap 1, fixed in 1.24)
a blob survives its strand hibernating and waking (blob pieces are in memory)
recovery with an offline backup owner key: the step 'R admits the new phone P as an owner' times out on sereus 1.24 — not yet known whether the stack or this script is out of date
